h04.

**no**; The `store.Driver` MySQL implementation (`mysql.DB`, constructed by `mysql.NewDB` in `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`) is only ever called from the driver-selection factory `NewDBDriver` in `store/db/db.go`:

```18:27:/bench/repo/store/db/db.go
	switch profile.Driver {
	case "sqlite":
		driver, err = sqlite.NewDB(profile)
	case "mysql":
		driver, err = mysql.NewDB(profile)
	case "postgres":
		driver, err = postgres.NewDB(profile)
	default:
		return nil, errors.New("unknown db driver")
	}
```

A repo-wide search confirms `mysql.NewDB` and the `store/db/mysql` package are imported/called nowhere else (`grep -rn 'mysql\.NewDB\|store/db/mysql"' --include=*.go` → only `store/db/db.go`).

Test helpers (`store/test/store.go` `NewTestingStore`/`NewTestingStoreWithDSN`) also go through `db.NewDBDriver(profile)`, i.e. the same factory, rather than calling `mysql.NewDB` directly.

The other places importing `github.com/go-sql-driver/mysql` are unrelated to constructing this `store.Driver`:
- `store/test/containers.go` uses raw `sql.Open("mysql", dsn)` and `mysqldriver.ParseDSN` purely to spin up/manage a throwaway MySQL testcontainer and per-test databases — it never builds the `mysql.DB` type.
- `store/db/mysql/auth_config.go` and its test only use `mysqldriver.MySQLError` for error-code checks, not driver construction.
